knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A damaged cord is an electrical hazard; the supply is isolated and the repair referred to a licensed electrician.
Particles shade water from UV light, so it is not fully treated; clear the water first.
An aquarium heater is not designed for ponds; it is not used and the owner is told.
The circulation loop section says water is moved through a filter where solids are caught and bacteria break down waste.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes procedure step 1: Record the layout of the circulation loop before any component is touched.
Learner completes procedure step 2: Isolate the pump or UV unit at its isolator, and prove it off where the procedure requires.
Learner completes procedure step 3: Check the cord along its length, the connections you can see from outside, and the position of the intake against the sediment.
Learner completes procedure step 4: Clean the intake screen and pre-filter basket, and check the air tubing and diffuser stones.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 1: Record the layout of the circulation loop before any component is touched.
Record of procedure step 5: For a UV unit, let the lamp cool if the procedure requires it, keep your eyes away from the lamp, and clean the sleeve only as the manufacturer directs.
Record of procedure step 6: Clean filter media in pond water, one section at a time, and record which sections were cleaned.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 2 is not done: Isolate the pump or UV unit at its isolator, and prove it off where the procedure requires.
